title: D11 agent output (d11-group-confirmer)
description: Section 12/D11 'Agent output' line and .claude/agents/d11-group-confirmer.md's worked output shape: {"groups": [{"fact_line","first","members": [{"id","label"}]}], "related": [{"id","related_to"}], "removed": [...]}. Spec 12/D11's Checks — every input member exactly once, first = earliest year/sitting, groups >= 2 members, runs agree — need the candidate group's own member table; the first three live in scripts/checks/D11.py and 'runs agree' is cross-run logic in step_plugins.D11Plugin.check() (the same split as D1/D2/A4). Note that `same_concept_different_fact` and `different` are NOT repeat_label values (config/allowed_values.yaml repeat_label has five): those two outcomes are expressed by WHERE a member goes — `related` or `removed` — exactly as codebook/D11.md §3 states. `note` is optional, carrying Universal rule 7 (added deliberately: its absence from schemas/D1.json/D2.json was a real bug, docs/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md 2026-10-12).

fact_line.description: The group's shared fact — the fact, not the longest member's stem (codebook/D11.md §4 step 5).

first.description: The id of the earliest member (earliest year; earliest sitting within a year). Every label in `members` is relative to THIS member, never to the member before it.

label.description: config/allowed_values.yaml repeat_label. Exactly one member of each group carries `first`, and it must be the member named by the group's own `first` field (checked in scripts/checks/D11.py).

related_to.description: The group's first member this one is related to (same concept, DIFFERENT fact — spec's own 2013#7 n-type vs 2019#33 p-type boundary case).

removed.description: Members D9 over-collected that are not the same concept at all. Removing is a correct outcome, not a failure (codebook/D11.md §3).

oneOf.description: Universal rule 8: if the input file is missing or broken, the agent writes only {"error": "..."}.
